item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of an Egyptian battlefield operation that clearly violated civilian-protection, prisoner-treatment, necessity, or proportionality standards. I also did not find direct operational reporting on Egyptian prisoner treatment in a combat context. The record is therefore mostly indirect, based on Sisi’s repeated public support for ceasefires, humanitarian access, and limiting escalation around Gaza and Rafah. The best-supported reading is that he publicly favored de-escalation and civilian protection, while the contrary evidence is too weak and contested to show a clear breach.","evidence":[{"title":"President El-Sisi and Jordan’s King Abdullah II Hold Talks in Amman","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/new142024-2/","summary":"Sisi joined a call for an immediate ceasefire and warned that any military operation in Rafah would have grave consequences.
